checks.name: manual RTL review
checks.details: Three-state Moore FSM; copies zeros and first one, then inverts remaining sampled bits. Output depends only on state. State updates on positive clock edges, with positive-edge asynchronous active-high reset to zero-output state. All next-state paths assigned.

checks.name: Icarus development compile
checks.details: Used requested Icarus path, -g2012, -Wall and explicit dev_tb top. Compiler exited without diagnostics or a simulation executable.

checks.name: development simulation
checks.details: Matching vvp could not open dev_sim. Independent testbench includes exhaustive arithmetic comparisons for widths 1 through 10, Moore output stability, a 256-bit stream and repeated asynchronous resets, but these checks did not execute.

development_outcome: Initial RTL delivered unchanged; candidate_initial.sv preserved before all development checks. Simulation unverified due to compiler failure.
